metric_type_note: canonical_screen_bt -> build_benchmark_compare (NW lag-3). Screening-grade, NOT forge-authoritative. Capital admission requires forge build_bt_result. Numbers here are so far below every threshold that a forge build would not change the verdict.
verdict_detail: DECISIVE CLEAN NEGATIVE for the deployable (monthly-carry, M03-gated top-25) construction. This is the campaign's FIRST top-concentration-DESIGNED concept, and the make-or-break decile test FAILS: the extreme top (D10) is flat/inverted, NOT top-concentrated. The AX-007 wall (real signal stranded short/mid-decile, top cannot harvest) HOLDS for this construction. SCREEN_ROUTE is NOT alpha approval — it routes ONE real but post-hoc sub-signal (fresh-disclosure-month drift) to a separate event-driven hypothesis WT + DPL feature, not to capital. Per AX-000 (amended 2026-06-21), a clean negative reported faithfully IS success. NO structural-limit / dead-end declaration is made — the disclosure-drift channel is a live follow-up hypothesis.
confidence_vector_note: Cross-sectional rank-IC = -0.0002 raw / 0.0043 sector-neutral (ICIR 0.022) => effectively zero deployable predictive confidence for the monthly-carry confirmed-buyback score. No deployable per-name confidence vector is emitted because the signal does not pass screening. Confidence is meaningful ONLY in the fresh-disclosure cohort (see spike_survival), which is a NEW-HYPOTHESIS candidate, not admission evidence.

factor_specs.proxy: BuybackYield_Confirmed = clip(TTM_4Q buyback KRW / MktCap, 0, 0.5) * 1{M03 > cross-sectional median}
factor_specs.formula: score_i = clip(SBB_ttm_i / Size_i, 0, 0.5) * (M03_i > median_t(M03)); SBB_ttm = rolling 4Q trailing sum of .cache/stock_buyback.parquet Value; M03 = Close(t)/Close(t-3m)-1
factor_specs.lag_rule: buyback Factor_Date = Period_Date + 45d (C4, asof Factor_Date <= sig_date); price t-1; forward Ret_1m (C2); liquidity adv20 lagged to t-1 (C10, fixed post-Codex)
factor_specs.neutralization: Size-normalized (yield basis); cross-sectional median gate per month (C1). Sector-neutral IC also computed (RF-A4): 0.0043 (no rescue).
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Buyback = costly credible insider commitment + mechanical demand bid + Ikenberry post-announcement underreaction drift; M03 gate intended to filter defensive value-trap buybacks. Buy-side only (designed to escape the AX-007 no-short trap). EMPIRICAL RESULT: the drift is real but exists ONLY in the fresh-disclosure month (+0.42%/mo) and is diluted to zero by the 3-month quarterly carry (carry months -0.28%/mo); the M03 gate does NOT improve and slightly harms (base PORT_t 0.044 < ungated 0.353).
factor_specs.redundancy_cluster_id: event_buyback_drift (NEW; no M* factor uses buyback; active corr vs WML momentum -0.073 confirms non-redundant)

diagnostics.ic_t_vs_portfolio_alpha_t_note: rank-IC t (-0.016) and portfolio-alpha t (0.044) both near zero and AGREE: no signal. No divergence to reconcile (unlike Cycle 2).

decile_test.status: FAILED — make-or-break: top NOT concentrated, flat/inverted
decile_test.procedure: per-month drop score==0, decile-rank confirmed score over active subset (median 47 active names/mo), forward 1M EW net active (decile - BM). D10/D9 PORT_t via canonical_screen_bt on the decile-as-portfolio (contract-grade); D10-D9 gap NW lag-3 via sandwich::NeweyWest.
decile_test.interpretation: D10 (highest buyback-yield-confirmed) earns -0.7% annualized active (flat/negative). D9 (+3.7%) > D10. D10-D9 gap is NEGATIVE and insignificant (t=-0.49). The extreme top does NOT add beyond merely-high; concentration is anti-helpful (top-15 PORT_t 0.165 > top-25 0.044 is a small concentration tilt but both ~zero and far below 2.0). honest_risk #1 (TOP-GOES-FLAT: KR buybacks are defensive value-trap survivors) is REALIZED. The decile profile is non-monotone noise (spearman 0.48), not a usable signal.

spike_survival.status: THE ONE REAL SUB-SIGNAL — but post-hoc; NEW-HYPOTHESIS candidate only, NOT admission evidence (per Codex C3 / RF-A6)
spike_survival.caveat: This split was inspected AFTER seeing the failed monthly-carry result (post-hoc). It has NO portfolio-level NW t-stat, NO transaction-cost-adjusted backtest, NO holdout/lockbox split. It is suitable ONLY as a new hypothesis to be tested prospectively in a fresh event-driven WT (1-month holding of the fresh-disclosure cohort), NOT as evidence for any DPL/overlay admission now.
spike_survival.interpretation: Within D10, active return is concentrated in the fresh-disclosure month (+0.42%/mo, ~+5%/yr) and turns negative in carry months 2-3 (-0.28%/mo). The Ikenberry drift appears real but SHORT-LIVED (~1 month); the monthly quarterly-carry construction averages the positive fresh pop with negative carry months => net zero. honest_risk #4 (quarterly-carry dilution) is the mechanism of failure.

ablations.interpretation: (i) The M03 confirm gate HURTS: ungated PORT_t (0.353) > M03-gated base (0.044). The 'confirmed' label adds nothing for M03; per spec orthogonality_targets the M03 gate should be dropped. (ii) Size-normalization MATTERS: raw KRW (un-normalized) PORT_t = -0.304 (worst), confirming SBB/Size yield is the correct construction (raw re-ranks toward large absolute-buyback large-caps). (iii) Longer-momentum gates monotonically improve (M03 0.044 < M06 0.608 < M12 0.797) and longer TTM (8Q 0.686) helps — but ALL variants remain far below 2.0 screening / 2.95 graduation. No variant is graduate-able. These are IS-only DIAGNOSTIC variants, NOT a sweep picking a winner for graduation (selection_type='single').

gate_fill_frequency.interpretation: Gate over-thinning (honest_risk #2) is NOT the failure cause: median 47 active names/mo, only 4/257 months below 25 (ungated fill rarely triggered). The failure is genuine flatness, not a thinning artifact.

orthogonality.basis: active (-BM) net return series, monthly, n=255 (kr_factor_returns_v2)
orthogonality.interpretation: PASSES all orthogonality targets on active basis: |corr| vs momentum 0.073 (<<0.40 — NOT repackaged momentum; the M03 gate did NOT re-introduce momentum-beta, honest_risk #3 not realized), vs value 0.011 (<<0.35 — buyback-specific not value-beta), vs size 0.205 (<0.35). The signal is genuinely buyback-specific and orthogonal to the M* family — but orthogonal AND with no alpha (measurement-graduation §6: orthogonal != return; PORT_t is binding and it fails). corr 0.80 vs unconfirmed confirms the gate adds no incremental value.

liquidity_distribution_D10.interpretation: D10 is NOT a micro-cap basket: median 20d ADV 4.36e9 (>> 2e8 floor), median market cap 5.11e11 (large-cap), only 7% of D10 names below 5e8 ADV. honest_risk #5 (size-norm artifact) mitigated. The flatness is a genuine return phenomenon, not an illiquidity/micro-cap artifact.
